What I'd tell a brand team

  • Early buzz is common, not a green light. Search interest was at least a little higher, compared with the brand, before RISE comebacks (STRONG by more than 15%), including FADED of the ones that faded.
  • What I'd test next: does demand hold after the first spike? A limited run or a few regions could show it.
